g.text: Key finding: pockets cut out around the bound ligand carry the ligand's size

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: On TOUGH-M1, similar ligands have similar sizes, so a ligand-shaped pocket lets almost any descriptor “cheat”. Detected pockets remove the shortcut.
